name: Aegis-Doom Airspace Classifier
author: Antigravity CTF Team
description: Latveria's border defense runs an automated visual surveillance network ('Aegis-Vision') on drone interceptors to shoot down intruder aircraft. An interceptor photo of your stealth glider ('infiltrator.png') is currently classified as 'AVENGER_INFILTRATOR' with 100% confidence. You have obtained a copy of the model weights ('aegis_weights.json'). Perform a white-box targeted adversarial evasion attack (FGSM/PGD) to fool the classifier into predicting 'PEACEFUL_BALLOON' with >= 90% confidence, while keeping maximum perturbation within Linf <= 12/255. Submit your perturbed image to the border verification API to obtain clearance.
hints: The classification model is a linear layer (logits = x @ W + b) followed by softmax. Because you have the full white-box weights (W), you can directly compute the input gradients.

Apply the Targeted Fast Gradient Sign Method (FGSM). To maximize the probability of class 2 ('PEACEFUL_BALLOON') relative to competitor classes, adjust each pixel by eps = 12/255 in the direction of W[:, 2] - W[:, competitor], then clip pixel values to [0, 1].
